label: Langrisser IV/V container family
_comment: The engine both games were built on, on every console they reached. Releases name it so tools know which loaders can read them; a Langrisser built on different code gets its own engine rather than flags on this one.

glyph._comment: Rows are packed continuously, 12 bits per row MSB-first, so a glyph is 18 bytes and slot N starts at N*18 from the plane offset. Both the SYSTEM UI text and the SCEN dialogue index this one plane.
